text.description_html:
ACORN-ST4BI, Smooth Black Iron Privacy Door Knob Set

Door knobs with a solid black finish are not easy to find especially of this quality. It is easy to install and has a lifetime no-rust warranty. A privacy knob, this smooth black iron knob is for doors that might need to be locked such as bedroom or bathroom.

Good for both exterior and interior use.

Also available matching:
Smooth Black Iron Passage Set
Smooth Black Iron Keyed Entry Set

Features of Smooth Iron Door Knob Set:

  • Passage latch set for 1-3/4" or 1-3/8" thick doors
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Fits pre-drilled doors.
  • Complete with rose and tubular latch.
  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!



**This item is Discontinued. See available Door Knobs
